msContents.summary: Pibesis, son of Peteese, is confirmed by his son, Teos, son of Pibesis, wab priest at the Chnoum temple, of having paid 1 silver deben to the collection box of Farnava. Compare Pap Berlin P. 23594.

support.note: Three continuous vertical sheet joins (kollesis), on the left side (3,5 cm), in the middle (ca. 1,5), as well as at the very right rim (2 cm).

list.item: object's condition: complete The right edge is broken off. Some vertical breaks along the folding.
text's condition: complete Beginning of all lines at a length of about 15 mm lost, otherwise complete.

35th regnal year, Phamuti of Pharaoh Dareios LPH. Payment receipt issued by the second wab priest of Chnoum the Great, lord of Elephantine,
Teos, son of Pibesis: 1 silver (deben), refined(?) According to Martin, Demotic Texts (1996), no.C35. ..?.. according to the fifth, which has brought Pibesis, son of Peteesis, his father, to the collection box of Farnava,
[the chief of the] Southern Land, to whom the fortress of Syene is entrusted, Total: 2 silver (deben), refined(?) ..?.., according to the fifth, to the collection box of Farnava, the chief of the Southern Land,
to whom the fortress of Syene is entrusted, They were received, as they are delivered, and as their payment which was made for him before was in them. Written by Espmetis, son of Haryotes.
